fact: The Libyan National Statistics Development Strategy (NSDS) 2018-2023, issued by the Bureau of Statistics and Census under the Ministry of Planning with PARIS21 and UNFPA, is presented as Libya's first national statistics strategy, to be applied over 2018-2023, with the Minister of Planning recommending it and asking stakeholders to support its implementation; no adoption decree is stated and the date is the document's published date (2018-04).
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): NSDS 2018-2023.
